Marianne Vinbæk is a Chief Physician (Overlæge) affiliated with Aalborg University Hospital in the North Denmark Region (Region Nordjylland) [^src1]. She represents the Danish Surgical Society (Dansk Kirurgisk Selskab) within the national clinical quality infrastructure [^src1].

Specifically, Vinbæk serves as a member of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe]] [^src1]. Her role on this committee provides surgical professional representation for the North Denmark Region, contributing to the interdisciplinary and cross-regional governance of the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB) [^src1]. The AKDB is a clinical quality database under the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP), and its steering committee is responsible for overseeing the database's clinical indicators, research background, and operational frameworks [^src1].
